goal: Automates installing bash and fish shell completion scripts via cmake so packagers get working tab-completion without manual copying
reviewability: Ready to review now, author just force-pushed to address the main outstanding feedback
No CI failure or rebase issue, remaining architecture debate wasn't pressed as blocking
agreement: Multiple concept ACKs without much elaboration (caesrcd, w0xlt, hebasto)
Verified by testing the completions work (BrandonOdiwuor, 151henry151)
Code review ACK with a keyword-consistency concern that the author then fixed (ryanofsky)
Nonblocking objection: install_binary_component becoming an unwieldy wrapper, countered with precedent (purpleKarrot, hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it's a packaging convenience rather than a core build or release-integrity fix
Saves packagers a manual step of copying completion scripts, benefiting end users with tab-completion out of the box
Does not affect reproducibility or supported platforms, and long-term maintenance commitment is still an open question
